title: Quest 4: The Voice of the Oracle

stages.question: Write the empty help texts in telescope.py (Part 1). Then run `python check.py --part 1`. What word did the checker give you?
Show the default values in the help (Part 2). Then run `python check.py --part 2`. What word did the checker give you?
Write the description and the examples (Part 3). Then run `python check.py --part 3`. What word did the checker give you?
Add the commands and their help to your team's game (Part 4). Then run `python check.py --part 4 YOUR-ID/YOUR-GAME`. What word did the checker give you?
